name: The Great Outdoors
label: Quest
description: The Great Outdoors introduces wandering adventurers to the essentials of wilderness survival and campcraft. By taking a seat at Eric's campfire…
intro: The Great Outdoors introduces wandering adventurers to the essentials of wilderness survival and campcraft. By taking a seat at Eric's campfire, travelers learn how to recuperate properly in the wild before taking up tradeskills to support their journeys.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, priest. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.
Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
